gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Noto Sans Lisu reads crisp and open, with sizable gaps near the tops of its ascenders. Wallpoet earns its place when set big and brief, where its bold, stenciled-looking lines can take over.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Wallpoet's most striking habit is the gap of paper showing through between its letters. Noto Sans Lydian is the friendly one, with capitals barely taller than lowercase, while the heading does the commanding.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Noto Sans Mahajani has lowercase standing tall against its capitals. Wallpoet's bold display shapes sit above that modern plain sans, loud where the body text is funnel-open and easy to follow.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Smooth, unobstructed curves around every bend give Wallpoet its commanding look. Noto Sans Malayalam then fills the line with a dense middle zone and an s that opens generously, so paragraphs feel approachable.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Wallpoet brings a bold, commanding display voice, with lowercase that rises high and paper showing between letters. Noto Sans Mandaic stays curvy and unclamped.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen keeps its small letters proud, nearly capital-sized, with curves ending in clear daylight. Noto Sans Marchen is the clean, quiet half, while Wallpoet's commanding display punch makes the standout quality here.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numer: Wallpoet is a bold display face with lowercase that rises high and light slipping between its letters. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals follows with a gaping c.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Noto Sans Medefaidrin reads contemporary, its tall lowercase turning curves without any ink pooling. Wallpoet takes the commanding display role above it, and the plain sans below keeps the page moving.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-meetei-maye: Noto Sans Meetei Mayek reads modern and spacious, its rounds gapping like a cracked bangle. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek has large lowercase eyes that make a long passage feel light underneath Wallpoet's bold display.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikak: Wallpoet leaves a line of paper showing through between its letters, a bold, commanding trait. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight through every curve, while Wallpoet earns its keep when big and brief.
